title: Obligations Placed on Digital Advertising and Internet Intermediaries under Code of Practice for Transparency of Online Political Advertisements
what_it_is: Obligations Placed on Digital Advertising and Internet Intermediaries under Code of Practice for Transparency of Online Political Advertisements

sections.label: Code duties for intermediaries
sections.summary: The Code requires prescribed intermediaries to ensure online political advertisements carry disclosure notices and to maintain a database and public reporting channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Code requires these prescribed intermediaries to ensure that online political advertisements carry disclosure notices to inform readers of the person or organisation that had placed or paid for the political advertisements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Intermediaries are also required to put in place other accountability measures, such as the maintenance of a database of online political advertisements, and the provision of channels for members of the public to report advertisements that are undisclosed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: In drafting the Code, the POFMA Office held consultations with the intermediaries and took reference from other jurisdictions, including the European Union (EU) Code of Practice on Disinformation, and the transparency measures imposed on political advertising in France and Canada.

sections.label: Purpose of the Code
sections.summary: The Code of Practice for Transparency of Online Political Advertisements will enhance transparency, hold advertisers accountable and enable citizens to make informed decisions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Code of Practice for Transparency of Online Political Advertisements will enhance the transparency of online political advertising, hold advertisers accountable and enable our citizens to make informed decisions on the information presented to them through political advertisements.

sections.label: Disclosure applies to all advertisements
sections.summary: The disclosure requirement applies to all advertisements because it is a code under POFMA.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The question is then whether this disclosure requirement applies to all advertisements because it is a code under POFMA and the answer is yes, it does.

sections.label: Intermediaries keep the information
sections.summary: The requirement is imposed on intermediaries to keep the information, which must be available if action is required.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: This is a requirement imposed on the intermediaries to keep the information.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: It does not mean that POFMA Office has to have access to this information.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But the information must be available so that in the event that action is required, the relevant information is available.

sections.label: Platforms' political advertising policies
sections.summary: Google and Twitter do not take political ads, while Facebook makes full disclosure beyond what the Code requires.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Google is not taking them; Twitter is not taking them; and it is a global policy not to take political ads; and Facebook is making full disclosure, more than the disclosure that we require through this Code.
